speaker: Devotee (invoking)
question: Who conquers?
premises: Grown-great with glory-compassion-awakening-bliss wealth, knowledge-lit in greatness.
He conquers, undefeated.
inference: The undefeated one conquers, grown great with auspicious wealth.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow?
premises: Forth-flowing drop-resonance; pure-nectar self.
Endless light; Śaṅkara milk-ocean.
inference: Bow to Śaṅkara milk-ocean, pure-nectar self, endless light.

speaker: Devotee (confessing hate and praise)
question: How do hate and praise both reach you?
premises: We hate you, we praise you; to you we address (tubhyam mantrayāmaḥ).
By great accessibility, well done: the all you have held for us (Kṣemarāja M00089: praise is realization of the non-dual Lord appearing in diversity).
inference: Hate and praise are both address to Ambikā's husband, who holds the all.

option_choices.reason: M00089 tubhyam mantrayāmaḥ and rahasyācāra context: public address/invocation, not private counsel; dative tubhyam as addressed-to.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — withdrawn touch, full nectar?
premises: Withdrawn-touch-yoked; full-nectar-streamed; sky-and-māyā-formed.
To the vast, to Śambhu: bow.
inference: Bow to vast Śambhu of withdrawn touch and full nectar.

option_choices.reason: Dative address series (vibhave … śambhave … namaḥ): to-the-vast, not locative in-prosperity.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: What form do we bow?
premises: Among the split, not split; among the cut, uncut indeed.
All-common form, that supreme Lord's: we bow.
inference: Bow to the all-common supreme form, undivided in division.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — minute and great?
premises: Than praṇava's upper half-mora even, to the minute, again to the great.
Than the world-egg even: to qualityless-qualified, to Sthāṇu — bow.
inference: Bow to Sthāṇu beyond measure, minute and great, qualified by qualitylessness.

option_choices.reason: Same referent; T1 compound-ordered paradoxical epithet kept as address; alternative is rebracketing, not rival reading.

speaker: Devotee (praising)
question: What power do we praise?
premises: World-egg-wombing; of sky-pervading, of all-going, of supreme-Lord-goose.
Power — goose-like — we praise.
inference: Praise the goose-like power of the supreme goose.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — no material, no wall?
premises: Provision without material; on no wall indeed, they extend the world-picture.
Bow to him, art-praised trident-bearer.
inference: Bow to the trident-bearer extending the world-picture without ground.

option_choices.reason: Transitive world-picture object (jagaccitraṃ): they extend it; middle-voice shading is not a rival claim.

speaker: Devotee (begging)
question: What milk do we beg?
premises: From māyā-water's belly fully drawn out, made stainless: Śiva-knowledge.
Of itself milked: give, come, O Hara-goose, to us.
inference: Beg Śiva-knowledge, milked stainless from māyā.

speaker: Devotee (offering)
question: To whom offer?
premises: Even in six-valid-means-delimitation-difference yoga: to the undivided.
To ultimate-truth-one-being: offering we go — to Bhava, to you.
inference: Offer to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being, beyond the six means.

option_choices.reason: Same yoga; T1 locative kept, alternative is rebracketing.
